full_prompt_en: A square, carefully modeled oil painting shows two fluffy kittens resting close together on a worn stone ledge. The background is a deep warm brown wall with subtle paint variation and no visible opening or distant view. Its broad darkness makes the pale fur and small eyes stand forward. On the left, a black and white kitten sits slightly farther back, its head lifted and turned toward the upper left. One greenish eye is clear beneath a dark patch of fur, and a tiny pink nose interrupts its white muzzle. Dark ears and fine pale hairs break the edge of the head against the shadow. On the right and nearer to the viewer, a cream and warm brown kitten lies with its chest spread over the ledge. It also looks toward the left, though its golden eye and pointed ear face more directly outward. Long white fur around the cheeks, chest and body is built from many short, soft strokes, while brown fur gathers around the crown and the outer ear. The two bodies overlap at the center and fill most of the lower half. The ledge below them is rough beige stone, mottled with gray cracks and chipped dark marks along the front edge. No collars, toys or other objects compete with the pair. Warm light falls gently from the upper left and front, making the pale faces and chest fur luminous while the darker backs blend into the wall. The eyes receive small, precise glints, but the stone stays matte and coarse. Fine hairlike paint strokes contrast with smoother blended shadow in the background. The overall composition places two soft, alert faces above one heavy horizontal ledge, balancing delicate cream texture against a deep brown enclosure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、塑形细致的油画描绘两只毛茸茸的小猫挨在一起卧于磨旧石沿。背景是一面深暖褐色墙，颜料有细微变化，没有可见开口或远景。大片深色使浅毛和小眼睛从中凸显。左侧，黑白小猫坐得稍后一些，抬头转向左上方。一只带绿色的眼睛从深色毛块下清楚露出，小粉鼻点在白口鼻上。深色耳朵与细浅毛丝打破头部在阴影前的边缘。右侧且更靠近观者，奶油白与暖褐色小猫把胸口铺在石沿上。它也望向左侧，但金色眼睛和尖耳更直接地朝向画外。脸颊、胸部与身体周围的白长毛由许多短而柔的笔触搭成，褐毛集中在头顶和外耳。两只身体在中央重叠，占去下半幅大部分。下方石沿是粗糙米色石材，灰裂纹和深色崩痕沿前缘斑驳分布。没有项圈、玩具或其他物件与它们争夺注意力。暖光从左上与正前方轻轻落下，使浅色面孔和胸毛发亮，较深背部则融入墙面。眼睛有小而准确的亮点，石面却保持哑光粗粝。细毛丝般的笔触与背景较平滑融合的阴影形成对照。整体构图在一条厚重水平石沿上放置两张柔软而警觉的脸，以细致奶油色肌理平衡深褐色围合。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely brushed oil-painted surface, contrasting dense, hairlike strokes with large blended dark areas. Deep umber and near black enclose smaller cream, gray and warm tawny patches, so pale textures form the natural focal points. Soft edges dissolve into shadow, while selected eyes, fine strands and rough ledge marks become sharply legible. Gentle warm light from an upper frontal side lifts exposed contours without flattening the darker recesses. A broad horizontal base stabilizes closely overlapping rounded forms, and the space remains shallow and intimate. Matte coarse texture at the bottom contrasts with soft fibrous texture above it. The overall effect is tender and tactile, with a small light center held inside substantial warm darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细笔油画表面，密集毛丝状笔触对照大片融合的深色区域。深赭褐与近黑色围住较小的奶油白、灰与暖黄褐色斑块，使浅色肌理自然成为焦点。柔软边缘消融在阴影中，所选眼部、细丝和粗石沿痕迹则清楚可辨。来自上方偏正面的温和暖光提亮暴露轮廓，又不压平较深凹处。宽阔水平基底稳住紧密交叠的圆润形体，空间浅而亲近。底部哑光粗肌理与其上柔软纤维状肌理对照。整体效果温柔而可触，一小片亮中心被充足暖暗包住。
theme_en: Two fluffy kittens resting on a worn stone ledge against a dark wall
theme_zh: 两只毛茸茸的小猫靠着深色墙面卧在磨旧石沿上
name: Henriette Ronner-Knip
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
